d:
Celebrate the Prakash Purab of Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji with Nankana Sing along to the animated lyrical video of this devotional song, sung by Surjit Bhullar, with lyrics by Harpal Sursingh Wala and music by Joy Atul, from the album Naam Khumari.
Credits :
Song - Nankana
Album - Naam Khumari
Singer - Surjit Bhullar
Lyrics - Harpal Sursingh Wala
Music - Joy Atul
Label - Speed Records
